abstract: In our project, we have created a standalone website where anyone can log in and access the ratings and evaluations of teachers for each course offered at our school. Additionally, students can register their own accounts, which can be used to link to their enrolled courses and provide weekly evaluations and ratings for their teachers. Each school will also be given an administrator account, allowing administrators to register teacher accounts and create courses. Teachers can create new courses and view student evaluations of their performance using their unique email-based accounts. Our website also includes systems for filtering inappropriate language and dynamic character displays, making it more sophisticated and polished. We think that a teacher evaluation system is an essential tool for educational institutions to ensure high-quality instruction and effective learning outcomes.

canonical_title: A Smart Garden for Thai Plants
aliases: IoT Smart Garden for Thai Plant
advisor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Dobri Atanassov Batovski
committee: Asst. Prof. Dr. Anilkumar Kothalil Gopalakrishnan
abstract: This research aims to design and develop a smart garden system for Thai plants. The system incorporates sensors, automation, and data analysis to optimize the growth and health of selected Thai plants. The study investigates the use of available low-cost sensors to monitor soil moisture, temperature, humidity, as well as the use of automation for watering. Data collected from the sensors is further analyzed. The goal of this study is to improve the efficiency and productivity of Thai plant cultivation while reducing the labor and resources required.
